title: Closest Distance
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive the expression for the closest distance R.

title: Angular Deflection
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive the expression for the angular deflection in terms of cot(theta).

title: Differential Cross Section
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive the expression for the differential scattering cross section dσ/dΩ.

title: Energy Conservation
description: Important Criteria: The student should apply conservation of energy correctly in the derivation of R.

title: Angular Momentum Conservation
description: Important Criteria: The student should apply conservation of angular momentum correctly to relate V and R.

title: Impulse Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly set up and evaluate the impulse of the force acting on the particle.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common sign errors in the equations, especially in the impulse calculation.
